en.answer:
Ⓐ: Yes, you can.

Since the <<13896>> that activated its effect is still in the Monster Zone, <<11384>>'s effect is an effect that would destroy a card on the field.

Ⓑ: No, you cannot.
Since the <<13896>> that activated its effect no longer exists in the Monster Zone, <<11384>>'s effect is not an effect that would destroy a card on the field.

en.question:
Ⓐ: I activate <<13896>>'s effect by Tributing a monster other than itself, and my opponent activates <<11384>>'s『negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card』effect in response. Can I activate <<7734>>'s『when a card or effect is activated that would destroy a card(s) on the field』effect?

Ⓑ: I activate <<13896>>'s effect by Tributing itself, and my opponent activates <<11384>>'s『negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card』effect in response. Can I activate <<7734>>'s『when a card or effect is activated that would destroy a card(s) on the field』effect?
en.title: If a『negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it』effect is activated in response to a monster effect activation, can I activate <<7734>>'s effect in response?

ja.answer:
（A）発動できます。
効果を発動した「<<13896>>」はモンスターゾーンに残っていますので、チェーン２の「<<11384>>」の②の効果は『フィールドのカードを破壊する効果』として扱います。

（B）発動できません。
効果を発動した「<<13896>>」がフィールドに存在なくなっているため、チェーン２の「<<11384>>」の②の効果は『フィールドのカードを破壊する効果』として扱われません。
